Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Seattle Sun Flare in Black and White Canvas Print of Seattle, 30" x 10"
Colors: Multi
Materials: canvas
Camera flares become part of the metro landscape in this artistic photo of Seattle. Perhaps taken through the glass window of a plane about to land there, this photo will add a contemporary and cosmopolitan look to your room. A contemporary, sophisticated addition to your room Hand-stretched canvas on wood. 30" x 10" Ready to hang with hardware included. Made to order
